 O.P.), Dist.- Begusarai
 ... ... Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Sandip Kumar Gautam, Advocate

For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ramesh Chandra, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE HARISH KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 13-03-2024 Heard Mr. Sandip Kumar Gautam, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner, who happens to be the husband of opposite party no.2, apprehends his arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 258 of 2023, wherein cognizance has been taken for the offences punishable under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with opposite party no.2 on 05.03.2021 and in fact the present complaint case has been instituted on account of certain differences, which he Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.15215 of 2024(2)
dt.13-03-2024 wants to patch up and is ready to keep his wife with all dignity and respect.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, let notice be issued to the opposite party no. 2, both under registered cover with A.D. as well as ordinary process, the requisites of which must be filed within a period of two weeks from today.
5. Re-notify this case after receipt of service of notice on 24.04.2024 or on appearance of the opposite party no.2, whichever is earlier.

6. In the meantime, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioner in connection with Complaint Case No. 258 of 2023, pending before the court of learned Sub- Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Begusarai, till further order.

(Harish Kumar, J) uday/-
